title: Special N-extremal solutions to indeterminate moment problems
summary: For an N-extremal solution $μ$ to an indeterminate moment problem it is known by a theorem of M. Riesz that the measure $(1+x^2)^{-1}dμ(x)$ is determinate. For $0<α<1$ we show by contradiction that there exist indeterminate N-extremal solutions $μ$ such that $(1+x^2)^{-α}dμ(x)$ is determinate, and there exist also indeterminate N-extremal solutions $μ$ such that $(1+x^2)^{-α}dμ(x)$ is indeterminate.
